field_purposes.topic_id: stable local identifier for fixture and beat traceability
field_purposes.title: human-readable topic headline or RSS title equivalent
field_purposes.source_name: publication/feed/source label or explicit offline fixture label
field_purposes.source_url_or_placeholder: article/feed URL placeholder proving live fetch is still closed
field_purposes.published_at_or_placeholder: freshness marker placeholder for offline-only testing
field_purposes.summary: short source-bounded description, separate from the claim
field_purposes.key_claim: the claim allowed to influence the episode beats
field_purposes.why_it_matters: reason the topic can become an explainer capsule
field_purposes.uncertainty_or_boundary: known source limitation and diagnostic boundary
field_purposes.rights_status: rights/quote/media reuse status or explicit unknown placeholder
field_purposes.intended_episode_angle: the explanatory angle used by hook, implication, and close
field_purposes.excluded_claims: claims the beat generator must not produce
field_purposes.production_status: diagnostic_only until source and rights are reviewed
field_purposes.source_kind: declares the input as an offline RSS-like fixture, not a live feed
field_purposes.topic_category: diagnostic category used for routing and risk review
field_purposes.attribution_note: explains attribution limits for the offline source label
field_purposes.freshness_status: explicitly records that freshness cannot be evaluated
field_purposes.editorial_risk: compact route risk note for downstream gating
field_purposes.materialization_notes: states whether any YMM4 project was created or modified
